description.value: Jin Jiang Shanghai Restaurant is a sit-down restaurant on Kingsway in Burnaby specializing in traditional Shanghai cuisine, including Shengjianbao (pan-fried pork buns), Malan head, and Drunken Chicken. The restaurant emphasizes fresh, high-quality ingredients and a professional chef team blending heritage recipes with innovation. It offers both dine-in and online ordering for cyclists looking for a substantial meal along a busy urban corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 91m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the address as 5411 Kingsway Burnaby BC V5H 2G1 and phone 604-620-6755, matching OSM tags. Online ordering is mentioned ('Order online' / '在綫下單'), supporting takeout. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the address is in Burnaby — a minor jurisdictional mismatch worth correcting in the OSM record.
OSM name is 'Jin Jiang Shanghai Restaurant' but the website uses 'JIN JIANG SHANGHAI CUISINE' (English) and 'Shang Hai Jin Jiang' as the site title — slight branding inconsistency.
Full postal code (V5H 2G1) and city (Burnaby) are present on website but absent from OSM address tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate operating restaurant, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify these before inclusion.
